title: Vector Spaces Lab
description: Interactive companion to Chapter 3 of Leon, Linear Algebra with Applications: subspaces, span, deciding linear dependence, bases, change of basis, rank and nullity.
lede: Which sets behave like ℝⁿ, how much do a few vectors span, and how do you decide whether they are linearly dependent? Test subspaces by dragging vectors, let row reduction decide dependence and hand you the relation, read coordinates in any basis, and watch rank and nullity add up.
